goal:
Runs use server-stored Critic sealed suite only
WHY: Fixes F1 high-severity reward-hack bypass: client trivial tests (assert 1==1 x3, correct kinds) currently earn PASS and unlock PR, and the keyless stub suite can back a PASS.

SPEC: POST /v1/runs requires review_evidence_id: str pointing at server-stored POST /v1/candidates/review evidence. Server loads that evidence's review.sealed_tests, revalidates with critic.ensure_sealed_suite, and rejects stub reviews (stored stub is True) as ineligible. Runner executes ONLY the server suite; run['heldout_kinds'] derives from it. Client field heldout_tests: 422 when non-empty, ignored when empty (deprecated, documented for removal). Missing/unknown review id -> 404/409; shape-invalid or stub review -> 409 and no PASS-capable evidence is stored (never fall back to client suite). Valid review + fully-passing candidate still yields GH_INTEGRITY=PASS and G2_REQUIRED=PASS via existing apply_run path. /v1/pr/create unchanged and transitively safe.
Critic constraints: (1) the tracked tests already use the new contract via services/api/tests/critic_helpers.py (server_review + review_evidence_id) — read them. (2) The web Improvement Lab currently posts heldout_tests to /v1/runs, which this task makes a 422; keep it working: apps/web/lib/api.ts postRun sends review_evidence_id (the evidence_id returned by POST /v1/candidates/review) instead of heldout tests, and apps/web/app/lab/page.tsx passes it and enables Run only after a review. (3) Store review_evidence_id on the run evidence record.

ACCEPTANCE (your own plan): Client-only POST /v1/runs with 3 trivial kind-correct heldout_tests and no review_evidence_id is rejected (422/409), never PASS; Same trivial suite attached alongside a valid review_evidence_id is ignored/rejected and cannot flip the verdict; Keyless stub review (stub True) used as review_evidence_id can never yield GH_INTEGRITY=PASS or G2_REQUIRED=PASS; Valid server review + candidate passing both suites still yields all-PASS and unlocks /v1/pr/create; python -m pytest services/api -q passes
OUT OF SCOPE: services/api/evoforge/postgres_kernel.py; services/api/evoforge/kernel_api.py; docs/POSTGRES_KERNEL.md; docs/INTERNAL_KERNEL_API.md; ledger math and web UI changes
